verification.method: Translate the source syntax, expand its macro definitions, assemble for the 68000, link at the ROM address, and compare every emitted byte.
limitations: Historical MPW assembly has not been tested.
The translator supports the constructs used by the current excerpts.
Byte equality does not establish the exact historical source text or prove completion of the ROM.
